hooks.command: test -d .atomic || exit 0; p=$(cat); m=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.model // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$m" ]; then t=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$t" ] && [ -f "$t" ]; then m=$(jq -rs 'map(.message.model? // empty) | map(select(. != "")) | last // empty' "$t" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$m" ] && p=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -c --arg m "$m" '.model = $m' 2>/dev/null); fi; fi; printf '%s' "$p" | atomic agent hooks claude-code session-start || true
test -d .atomic && atomic agent hooks claude-code session-end || true
test -d .atomic && atomic agent hooks claude-code stop || true

test -d .atomic || exit 0; p=$(cat); m=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.model // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$m" ]; then t=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$t" ] && [ -f "$t" ]; then m=$(jq -rs 'map(.message.model? // empty) | map(select(. != "")) | last // empty' "$t" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$m" ] && p=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -c --arg m "$m" '.model = $m' 2>/dev/null); fi; fi; printf '%s' "$p" | atomic agent hooks claude-code user-prompt-submit || true
test -d .atomic && atomic agent hooks claude-code pre-task || true
test -d .atomic && atomic agent hooks claude-code post-task || true
test -d .atomic && atomic agent hooks claude-code post-todo || true
test -d .atomic && atomic agent hooks claude-code post-tool || true
